title: Config fuzzer: 120 random machines with invoke-onDone cycles and cross-region `always` never livelock (30 s watchdog)
intent: #144/#151: a conservative cycle must end on the budget, not spin for ever

title: 5000 snapshot mutations: every rejection is a typed XStateMachineError, never a bare TypeError/ValueError
intent: #146/#143: `except XStateMachineError` around a restore must be sufficient

title: Event-type fuzz: every hostile event shape raises InvalidEventError (#161), never anything untyped
intent: the send() door is the widest attack surface an OMS exposes

title: Hook matrix: guard_denied / unresolved_target / chain_budget / on_plugin_error / on_resolve_error each fire EXACTLY once
intent: an OMS reconciles from hooks; a double-fire double-books and a miss loses the order

title: #160: get_snapshot()'s DEBUG log is redacted — no iban/pan/cvc/otp value reaches the log stream
intent: a DEBUG-level log shipped to a vendor must not carry a PAN

title: Executor thread context leakage: a plain-def service sees no other machine's context and cannot mutate it in place
intent: #149 shares one pool across services; a shared pool must not share state

title: Exported API surface: every new round-5 name is importable and every error derives from XStateMachineError
intent: a typed contract the caller cannot import is not a contract
